title: state-machine.md: doc rows for H29/H30/H31 — docs-only PR after #11874 merges, paid by consolidation at 43/43
body:
Blocked-by: #11747

Follow-up split out of #11179 (ruled option B on its report's open question 2, ACCEPT comment on that card) — the seat-facing reference rows for the three invariants PR #11884 lands in `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`:

1. The general pm-state ONE-OF (H29): the six-member vocabulary is mutually exclusive intent; every transition is a replace, never an add.
2. The `pm:queue` rot horizon (H30): 3 days, derived from the 2026-08-24 live distribution — the queue is the one state where waiting is not a state.
3. The contract-review dual-carrier postcondition (H31): hung in one stroke, cleared in one stroke, card and PR both, read-back each way.

## Why blocked, and the payment plan

`references/state-machine.md` sits at line-ratchet ceiling **43/43**, and every currently-consolidatable line is inside PR #11874's hunks (the `pm:blocked` section it rewrites). Landing these rows before that merge would force exactly the textual conflict #11179's dispatch avoided. Once #11874 (and #11884) are on `main`: one docs-only PR, rows paid by consolidation from the then-uncontested purse, ceiling raise only if the arithmetic is argued. The file already names `check-half-states.mjs` as the enforcement authority, so nothing is un-enforced in the meantime — this card is about the seat-facing reference catching up, not about the mechanism.

Refs: #11179 (the ruling and inventory) · PR #11884 (H29/H30/H31) · #11747 / PR #11874 (the in-flight hunks this waits on).
